name: Guition 4.3" panel — wall shelf
description: A wall shelf for the Guition JC4880P443C. One part: a back plate with a screw ear each side, a floor and two side walls that hold the finished module, and 45° lead-ins at the mouth so it drops in instead of catching. The module is not fastened — it nests, standing up with its face out and fully visible, and lifts straight out to service. The pocket is sized from the module's own envelope.
